        Build code

        Use ⬇ Download at the top to save your robot as a file. Or copy this code. Paste a code and press Open code to load a robot.

        How to move around

        Drag a part to swing it on its pins. Drag empty space to look around. Right-drag to slide. Scroll or use + and − to zoom. One square on the mat is one hole (12.7 mm). Beams, plates, connectors, pins, shafts, gears and wheels use the real VEX IQ shapes. The motor, sensors and Gen 2 Brain are real VEX IQ shapes too. The omni wheel is a drawn stand-in for now.
